Subject: Kickoff: Reserved GPU onboarding & vendor timing (RID-439)

Team / Amy / Ian,

Quick kickoff note — Acme Data (deal RID-439) has a committed start date target of 2026-09-01 for dedicated capacity. High-level numbers: 120 A100-equivalent GPUs (we will provide final sizing matrix, attached). We need to align vendor OEM lead times, cloud reservation holds, and an interim bridging plan in case hardware lead times push past Sept.

Asks: 
- Amy / Orion: can you provide confirmed lead times for rack-level delivery for 120 cards (both standard-stock and custom config)? Please include procurement cut-off dates to guarantee Sep start.
- Ian / Nimbus: any short-lead inventory for 6–8 week delivery we could use as staging/rescue capacity?
- Procurement (Priyom) & Ops (Neha): what are the earliest PO and install windows given current data-center constraints?

Attachments: capacity_matrix_v2.xlsx (requested sizing), draft_onboarding_map.pdf (initial proposed milestones).

Goal: have a concrete plan and cost/lead-time options by next Tue (2026-07-06) so we can review with Acme and decide on a blended approach (reserved + cloud burst).

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Capacity Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Amy Wong <amy@orioncloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-01T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Reserved GPU onboarding & vendor timing (RID-439)

Vivek / team,

Thanks for the summary and attachments. Initial response from Orion Cloud ops:
- Standard rack-config (our stocked chassis + 4x A100 80GB per chassis): 8–10 weeks from PO receipt if stock available at time of order.
- Custom rack build (special networking, proprietary cooling): 16–20 weeks.
- Lead-time variability: +/- 2 weeks depending on supply (power supplies and passive cooling stacks are the usual choke points).

We can hold a provisional quote for 14 days without commitment. I'll push a formal DocuSign quote (standard config) by EOD tomorrow. For capacity holds in cloud (us-west2), we can reserve equivalent GPU capacity on our managed infra, but we need a signed commitment and region lock by 2026-07-20 to guarantee availability for Sep. Cloud-reserved option will carry a ~10% premium vs. hardware amortized.

Staging option: we can pre-stage 32 standard dev nodes in our managed fleet (available mid-August) — that would cover early customer onboarding while racks arrive.

I'll include specifics in the quote (SKU-level, shipping windows, and recommended expedite fees).

Regards,
Amy Wong
Partner Ops — Orion Cloud
amy@orioncloud.com

Date: 2026-07-02T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Reserved GPU onboarding & vendor timing (RID-439)

Thanks Amy — helpful. A few clarifications/requests from procurement/sales: 
- Customer target remains 2026-09-01 (hard). If Orion's standard stock path is 8–10 weeks we still need a bridging plan for early Sept if shipping slips by a few weeks.
- Ian: please confirm whether Nimbus has a limited-run 6–8 week offering (even if RMA/MTTR is higher). We are prepared to pay a short-term premium if it guarantees the go-live.
- Neha: please enumerate any data-center prep tasks (power, racked space, on-site crew) that require lead time so we can align PO timing.

Decision preference: prefer blended approach — procure fastest-stock hardware for initial 40–48 GPUs to hit go-live gates and then receive remainder on longer lead-time shipments. If cloud reserve is cheaper and instantly available for the first 3 months, we may prefer cloud bridging to reduce short-term capex.

Action: aim to have vendor quotes + internal DC readiness checklist by 2026-07-07. Prio: vendor shipping windows and any expedite costs.

Best,
Priyom
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com, Amy Wong <amy@orioncloud.com>, Ian Walters <ian@nimbus-hw.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-06T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Reserved GPU onboarding & vendor timing (RID-439)

Folks,

Operational constraints to call out (DC ops):
- Power provisioning: for 120 A100-equivalent GPUs we need ~75kW contiguous capacity per pod; PDU & breaker scheduling can take 4–6 weeks with our colo partner.
- Rack and network: 30U per rack estimated; lead time for pre-wired top-of-rack switches is currently 3 weeks if ordered this week.
- On-site install crew: earliest full install window available is the week of 2026-09-06 unless we push for a weekend install (which requires additional vendor fees).
- Cooling & site acceptance: any custom cooling layout requires facility approval (SLA/FTPA) and adds ~2–3 weeks.

Recommendation:
1) Open PO this week for stock hardware (target first shipment mid-August).
2) Parallel: place conditional cloud reserve with Orion for Sep (hold until 2026-07-20). If stock ships on time, we cancel the cloud hold.
3) Procure temporary 48-GPU staging (either Nimbus short-lead or Orion managed) to cover customer acceptance tests and initial rollout.

I've attached rack_power_plan.pdf with the power/cabinet assumptions. Procurement: please budget for expedited install fees and weekend labor as contingency.

-Neha
Senior Infra Ops — Redwood Inference
